newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore tyre producers in buying for RSS3 rubber.
newsitem.headline: Singapore tyre producers in buying for RSS3 rubber.

text.p: Singapore-based tyre manufacturers engaged in a bout of buying of RSS3 rubber on Thursday to cover their monthly requirements while dealings in other rubber grades were said to be thin, dealers said.
"Some tyre manufacturers bought their monthly requirement of RSS3 rubber. I think most of them bought rubber for nearby rather than forward delivery," a dealer said.
Dealers said the volume of RSS3 bought for nearby delivery by the manufacturers probably reached less than 4,000 tonnes.
"The buying was largely routine. The tonnages involved were modest and not really that large," one dealer said.

Some people in the trade said there was still persistent talk about a possible rubber deal between Thailand and China although industry officials and traders in Bangkok have already discounted the matter.

"I think some people are still waiting for news from Thailand that they will reach a deal with China," a trader said. At 0945 GMT, August RSS3 was seen at 117.00 U.S. cents a kg from 117.50 cents. July RSS1 was seen at 165.25 Singapore cents (US$1.15) a kg from 166.25 cents. July TSR20 was seen at 153.50 Singapore cents (US$1.07) a kg from 155.00 cents.
